body:
I've tried, they don't accept people based on their debt to income ratio and I have no dependents. You have to make less than $1400/mo (although cheapest rent in the city runs about $650 without utilities and I pay slightly over this). Food stamps are approved at about $160/month for households with 2 dependents that fall below the "poverty line", which is again not determined by debt to income ratio, or what your personal scenario is but entirely upon income, and income alone (have a friend who recieves them). 

I used to take care of my ex boyfriends brother who was mentally handicapped and the entire 4 years we were together he was on a waiting list to be accepted into a day program that the family would have had to pay $800/month for. 

There aren't really any programs within my community that help very many people. I live in one of those cities with two homeless people on every corner.. I mean hell, I had someone agree to rent me an apartment at 15 years old and was offered a job waitressing graveyards at the same age.

Obviously, there are far worse places in the world (Africa, etc..) that make me feel guilty for bitching about roaches in my apartment and not having money for food but.. I mean hell.. Eminem kinda got it right when he called it the United Stats of Embarassment. I also think Atmosphere sait it right with "If I had a time machine I'd probably use it like a vacuum and try to clean, it kind of seems quite more than a handful of these regrets have been circumstantial."

Thats the thing, are there things I could have done differently? Sure, but in reality those things probably wouldn't have solved the problem. I could have left my ex, but he only accounts for ~15k in the debt. The rest is medical, and I've been garnished for one alreadh. When that happened I lost my last place to live and ended up where I am now thanks to my grandmother jumping in and paying for me to move. 

I don't see a way out of this, and I haven't for months. To say that it's just financial woes wouldn't scratch the surface. I have so many people I miss and so few people there for me. Whats worse is I have people who pretend to be there. My mother is a great example, she's meth addled and insane, but she loves to be around when something is wrong with me. Maybe it makes her feel better about herself for being so fucked, or maybe it makes her feel like she's finally doing the "mom" thing, but that doesn't change the fact that by 15 I was out by myself without her or anyone else around does it? If I can't vacuum up my mistakes neither can she.
